name: System Support Holdings Inc.
summary: System Support Inc. provides IT services in Japan and internationally. Its software includes SHIFTEE, which manages shifts natively in the cloud, Tate Yakusha, covering data on construction projects, Shugyo Yakusha for tracking attendance, and voice-enabled applications such as Voicetant Writer and Voicetant Recorder. It also works with RPA, infrastructure, virtualization and workflow tools. Dating from 1980, it has its headquarters in Kanazawa, Japan.
